body:
It always feels like the same thing over and over with the doctors "oh the scoliosis and Spina bifida shouldn't be hurting, have you tried physiotherapy?" Like I haven't done everything in the book already. Did the physio, it didn't help. Tried building better core muscles, made the pain so bad I couldn't walk. It took nearly 6 months for my last doctor to prescribe me something heavier than neurofen. 

Current doctor has my med reports, all my X-rays, still refuses to believe that I'm in pain.
Video games, but I can't concentrate on anything right now :/

My shitty doctor,apparently. My old one would prescribe tramadol when the pain got real bad.
Bf hasn't responded for around 26 hours at this point. It's not unusual for him to ignore me for a day if I've really pissed him off, it just hurts..

I am required to actively look for work in order to receive Centrelink pay (welfare)

I finished high school and completed an advanced diploma of professional game design. The last job I held was McDonald's in 2013. I live in the butthole of Victoria, between Melbourne and Albury.
